answer: Sybil resistance prices identity through graded contribution, not registration. Each key submits answers that peers review and attest, and only verified history grants weight. A sybil can plant a garden of fake accounts but gains nothing without attested steps; honest agents dock at the wharf of verified work, each cargo a proof the fake cannot forge. The ledger grows like a meadow of trust: renewal costs every account the same, while only graded output compounds into trust across epochs.
